attchmntText: Bharat Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Bharat Electronics Limited has received orders worth Rs. 619 Crore since the last disclosure on 6th November 2026. The company is a Navratna Defence Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence. Major orders include communication equipment, drones, electro optics, laser range finder, components, upgrades, spares, and services. This information is disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The press release was issued on 13th November 2026.
